answerable.question: What is the minimum attendance percentage required to sit for the end-semester exam, according to Section 3?
What is the minimum CGPA a student must maintain to avoid being placed on Academic Probation?
Within how many working days of result declaration can a student request revaluation of an answer script?
What is the tuition fee for a UG student in the Odd semester of 2025-26?
Can a guest stay overnight in a student's hostel room?
answerable.expected_gist: No, not permitted under any circumstances

answerable.question: How many founding members are required to register a new student Society?
Can a student report ragging anonymously?
What CGPA must a Merit Scholarship recipient maintain to continue receiving it?
answerable.expected_gist: 8.0 (per Section 8.2, distinct from the contradictory 12.3 reference)

answerable.question: If a student arrives late to an exam, after how many minutes will they not be allowed to enter?
What is the maximum permitted duration of the B.Tech programme, including medical leave?
What happens to my exam eligibility if I miss classes because I had to attend my sister's wedding out of town?
answerable.expected_gist: Section 3.5 explicitly excludes family functions from condonation, so the normal 75% threshold applies with no exception -- this was originally mis-labeled NOT_FOUND, corrected after eval run revealed the corpus names this exact scenario.

answerable.question: Can I get my attendance shortfall condoned if I was traveling internationally for personal reasons during the semester?
answerable.expected_gist: Section 3.5 explicitly excludes personal travel from condonation -- no exception, regardless of domestic/international.

answerable.question: Does attending my sibling's graduation ceremony count toward the Medical Exemption Clause?
answerable.expected_gist: No -- Section 7 is explicitly medical-only, and Section 3.5 excludes family functions generally.

contradiction.question: What attendance percentage does a student need to maintain to continue receiving their scholarship?
contradiction.expected_gist: Section 3.2 says 75%, Section 12.3 says 80% while claiming to quote Section 3

contradiction.question: How much is the late fee if I pay my tuition fee one week late?
contradiction.expected_gist: Regulations Section 9.2 says flat ₹500/week; fee_deadlines.md says 2% of outstanding amount/week

contradiction.question: What time is the hostel curfew?
contradiction.expected_gist: Hostel handbook scope section says 11:00 PM; Section 5.1 says 10:00 PM

unanswerable.question: If I represent my city (not the Institute) in a personal, non-Institute-affiliated hackathon, can that count as grounds for attendance condonation?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Section 3.4 condonation requires the activity to be 'Institute-sanctioned'; a personal hackathon's status is never addressed.

unanswerable.question: Does the Medical Exemption's attendance denominator adjustment (Section 7.2) still apply if the medical absence happens during the Summer Term?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Section 13.2 says Summer Term attendance follows Section 3 in full, but never states whether the Section 7 medical adjustment mechanism itself is available in a Summer Term context.

unanswerable.question: If a Merit Scholarship recipient's CGPA drops because they took a Medical Leave of Absence semester, does the scholarship get paused rather than permanently lost?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Section 8.2 states the CGPA-below-8.0 consequence in general, and Section 7.3 describes Medical Leave separately, but their interaction is never addressed.

unanswerable.question: Can a student challenge an Academic Integrity Committee's finding through the Grievance Redressal Committee (Section 11) instead of the procedural review in Section 6.5?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Section 11.1 lists what the GRC handles and Section 11.4 excludes sexual harassment specifically, but never states whether Academic Integrity Committee findings can also go to the GRC.

unanswerable.question: If a student is expelled under Section 6.4 for a second academic integrity violation, can they ever reapply for admission in a future year?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: The corpus describes the expulsion but has no readmission policy anywhere.

unanswerable.question: Does a Society event that runs past 9:00 PM on a Saturday need the same Dean approval as a weekday event under Article 6.4?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Article 6.4 specifies 'weekday' explicitly; weekend late events are never addressed.

unanswerable.question: Can a first-year student, who hasn't completed two semesters yet, be elected as a Class Representative?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Article 2.2's two-semester eligibility rule is stated for Council-wide offices; Article 2.4 (Class Representatives) doesn't restate or exclude that rule, leaving first-year CR eligibility unaddressed.

unanswerable.question: If the Council Treasurer (an appointed, not elected, position) resigns mid-year, who fills the vacancy and how?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Article 3.3's vacancy-filling process is written for elected office-bearers; the Treasurer is explicitly appointed, and no vacancy process for appointed roles is given.

unanswerable.question: Is there a limit on how many different Societies a single student can hold an office-bearer position in at the same time?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Never addressed anywhere in the Constitution.

unanswerable.question: If I take a Medical Leave of Absence for a semester, how is my CGPA-based scholarship eligibility calculated for the semester right after I return?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Section 7.3 says no grades are recorded and the semester doesn't count toward programme duration, but never states how scholarship CGPA continuity is handled across that gap.

unanswerable.question: Does the attendance policy have any different provisions for international students who may have visa-related travel obligations?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: International students and visa considerations are never mentioned anywhere in the corpus.

unanswerable.question: Can a student on Academic Probation still hold a leadership position within a Society that isn't a Council office (e.g., a Society's internal head, not a Council Secretary)?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Article 2.3 restricts probation-affected students only from contesting Council offices; internal Society leadership roles are a separate thing never addressed.

unanswerable.question: Does the Institute provide extra time or accommodations during examinations for students with disabilities?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Accessibility is mentioned only for hostel room allotment (Section 2.1 of the hostel handbook); examination accommodations are never addressed.

unanswerable.question: Can a student doing a credit-bearing final-semester internship under Section 16.1 also register for regular, non-internship courses in that same semester?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Section 16 describes the internship track but never addresses whether it can be combined with regular course registration.

unanswerable.question: If a Warden refuses to grant a student a Night-Out Pass, can the student appeal that specific refusal?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Section 8.4 of the hostel handbook only covers appeals against Hostel Disciplinary Committee decisions; a Warden's refusal to issue a pass is a different, unaddressed situation.

unanswerable.question: Are hostel residents permitted to keep pets in their rooms?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Never mentioned anywhere in the hostel handbook.

unanswerable.question: What happens if a demand draft submitted for fee payment is dishonoured or bounces?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: The Fee Schedule describes how to submit a DD but never addresses a bounced or dishonoured DD.

unanswerable.question: If a scholarship recipient graduates early under Section 14.3, is any remaining scholarship amount paid out or forfeited?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Section 14.3 covers early graduation eligibility but says nothing about scholarship fund treatment in that scenario.

unanswerable.question: Does a national-level esports achievement qualify a student for a Sports Scholarship under Section 8.1?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Section 8.1 refers to 'state or national-level sporting achievement' without defining whether esports counts as a sport for this purpose.

unanswerable.question: If I'm approved for the two-installment tuition payment plan and then miss the second installment, does the provisional cancellation process in Section 9.3 apply the same way as it would to a normal missed payment?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: The installment plan note in fee_deadlines.md says late fees apply independently to each missed installment, but never states whether Section 9.3's provisional cancellation and its four-week timeline apply the same way to a missed installment as to a normal missed due date.

unanswerable.question: Can a Society use part of its Student Activity Fund allocation to pay a stipend or honorarium to a guest speaker?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Article 5 and 6 describe fund allocation and receipts generally but never address paying individuals (as opposed to venue/logistics costs).

unanswerable.question: If two Societies want to co-host a single event and split the funding request, how is the ₹50,000 approval threshold in Article 5.3 applied -- per Society or per event?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Article 5.3 states the threshold but the Constitution never addresses joint/co-hosted events or how the threshold applies when funding is split between two Societies.

unanswerable.question: If a student qualifies for both a Merit Scholarship and a Sports Scholarship in the same semester, can they receive both at once?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Section 8 defines eligibility criteria for each scholarship category independently but never states whether a student can hold more than one category simultaneously.

unanswerable.question: If a hostel resident switches from the "with mess" plan to the "without mess" plan partway through a semester, is any portion of the mess fee refunded or adjusted?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: The Fee Schedule lists amounts for each plan and the hostel handbook allows mess opt-out with Warden approval, but neither addresses a mid-semester switch or any resulting fee adjustment.

unanswerable.question: If two candidates receive the exact same number of votes in a Council election, how is the tie broken?
unanswerable.why_unanswerable: Article 2 describes the election process and eligibility but never addresses a tied outcome.
